endpoint.title: List products
endpoint.description: Returns the products, 9 per page. Without `is_rental`, rental products are excluded (`is_rental` defaults to false). _(verified)_

parameters.name: by_brand
parameters.description: Brand id, or several ids separated by commas

parameters.name: by_category
parameters.description: Category id, or several ids separated by commas

parameters.name: by_category_slug
parameters.description: Category slug; also matches its direct sub-categories. In the source, not in the spec.

parameters.name: is_rental
parameters.description: true` or `1` returns only rentals; anything else, or no value, returns only non-rentals

parameters.name: eco_friendly
parameters.description: true` or `1`: only products with CO2 rating A or B. In the source, not in the spec.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name contains this text. In the source, not in the spec.

endpoint.title: List products (HTTP QUERY)
endpoint.description: Same as `GET /products`, but the criteria are sent as a JSON body (RFC 10008 `QUERY` method). The body keys are merged into the query string, so the results equal the `GET` with the same parameters. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Create product
endpoint.description: Creates a product. No token is needed (see Notes). _(source)_

201.schemaRaw: Product   // with product_image, category and brand loaded

endpoint.title: Get product
endpoint.description: Returns one product with its category (including `parent_id`), brand, image and specs. _(verified)_

endpoint.title: Update product
endpoint.description: Updates a product with the fields sent. No token is needed (see Notes). Despite being `PUT`, no field is required. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Partially update product
endpoint.description: Updates only the validated fields that are sent. Unlike `PUT`, fields without a rule (`co2_rating`, `stock`) are dropped. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Delete product
endpoint.description: Deletes a product. Admin only. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Get related products
endpoint.description: Returns up to 10 other products from the same category as the given product. _(verified)_

200.schemaRaw: Array<Omit<Product, 'co2_rating'>>   // category has id and name only; no co2_rating field

endpoint.title: Search products
endpoint.description: Searches product names. Returns 9 per page. Special characters are stripped from `q`; an empty or missing `q` returns an empty page, not an error. _(verified)_

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term. The spec marks it required, but without it the API returns `200` with an empty `data` array.

endpoint.title: Search products (HTTP QUERY)
endpoint.description: Same as `GET /products/search`, with the criteria in a JSON body. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Login
endpoint.description: Returns a JWT for the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Accounts with two-factor auth (TOTP) get a restricted temporary token instead, which is exchanged for a full token by sending it back with the TOTP code. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Register
endpoint.description: Creates a customer account (role `user`). _(source)_

endpoint.title: Forgot password
endpoint.description: Sets the account's password to `welcome02`. No email confirmation or token is involved. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Change password
endpoint.description: Changes the current user's password. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Current user
endpoint.description: Profile of the user the token belongs to. `role`, `enabled` and `failed_login_attempts` are returned only when the caller is an admin. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Logout
endpoint.description: Invalidates (blacklists) the token. Later requests with it get `401`. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Refresh token
endpoint.description: Returns a new token for the one in the `Authorization` header and invalidates the old one. An expired token can still be refreshed within the refresh window (`JWT_REFRESH_TTL`, 60 minutes by default). This route has no auth middleware; the token is read by the handler. _(source)_

endpoint.title: List users
endpoint.description: Lists customer accounts (role `user` only), 15 per page. Admin only. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Search users
endpoint.description: Searches customer accounts (role `user` only) by first name, last name, email and city. Any logged-in user can search (see Notes). Returns 15 per page. _(source)_

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term. The spec marks it required; without it every customer matches.

endpoint.title: Search users (HTTP QUERY)
endpoint.description: Same as `GET /users/search`, with the criteria in a JSON body. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Get user
endpoint.description: Returns a user. A non-admin can only get their own record. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Update user
endpoint.description: Updates a user's profile. A non-admin can only update their own record; only an admin can send `role`. `password` is ignored (use change-password). _(source)_

endpoint.title: Partially update user
endpoint.description: Updates only the validated fields that are sent. A non-admin can only patch their own record. _(source)_

endpoint.title: Delete user
endpoint.description: Deletes a user. Admin only. _(source)_
